title: SYNAPEF one-day warning strike at Water and Forests ministry
location: Main gate of Ministry of Water and Forests headquarters; city unknown in body
threshold_50_evidence: Article reports a general assembly and agents barricading a ministry gate, but no number or qualitative threshold estimate; >=50 remains unknown.

start_date.summary: Article printed 8 Oct 2020 and says action was Wednesday; 7 Oct inferred, not explicitly printed in body.

location.summary: Main gate at headquarters of ministry; town not identified.

demands.summary: Payment of third-quarter bonus and arrears; strike explicitly linked to alleged breach of agreement with minister.

participants.summary: Agents held an assembly and barricaded the main gate until 18:00; no count.

threshold_50.summary: No numerical or clearly sufficient qualitative estimate.

notes: One account only; do not infer agent count from ministry-wide membership or strike status.
open_questions: Can a permitted report establish at least 50 participants at the gate?
Can the exact event locality/city be supported?
Was the described one-day strike a distinct assembly/action or part of a longer episode, and is there a next-month continuation?

title: Transport-ministry workers' strike picket with symbolic coffin
location: Courtyard of the Ministry in charge of Transport and Civil Aviation, Libreville (city from article metadata/tag; exact event site not named in body)
threshold_50_evidence: No number or qualitative estimate reported; cannot establish at least 50 at this picket.

start_date.summary: Article says union leader was arrested Thursday and picket was among reasons; it gives release Monday 26 Oct but not picket's exact onset.

location.summary: Article places a picket in ministry courtyard; Libreville is supported by prosecutor context/tag, not directly as courtyard address.

demands.summary: Article describes a symbolic coffin and arrest but no clear demand.

participants.summary: Ministry personnel on strike are mentioned, no attendance count.

state_response.summary: Article reports arrest of SAMTAC leader and charges of insult/premeditation.

notes: Keep distinct from SYNAPEF/Water and Forests strike; no basis to infer same episode.
open_questions: Can permitted reporting establish >=50 at this picket?
What demand, if any, did participants direct to the state/policy?
When did this picket begin, and was it a distinct action or part of a continuous strike?
